subject: CHANGELOG.md contains the heading ## [1.4.1] - 2026-09-30 and keeps an empty Unr
source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
text = Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text()
_, _, rest = text.partition("## [Unreleased]")
assert rest
body, sep, _tail = rest.partition("## [1.4.1] - 2026-09-30")
assert sep, "missing 1.4.1 section"
assert not body.strip(), repr(body)
assert "### Fixed" in text.split("## [1.4.0]", 1)[0]
assert "typer>=0.27.2" in text
assert "lowest-direct" in text
assert "__version__" in text
print("changelog 1.4.1 ok")'
